welcomeEntry.title: Welcome to DIASPORA.GA
welcomeEntry.lead: Check what members will see about you, then enter: one step is enough.
welcomeEntry.consent: When you create your profile, your display name, your handle and your country become visible to DIASPORA.GA members; the directory and notifications stay off until you turn them on.
